name: codex_run
description: Run one Codex turn in a fresh ephemeral thread and return a structured report. Write `brief` per bridge/DISPATCH.md (GOAL, SCOPE, VERIFY): the worker sees nothing else. Use role terra for modular units and role sol for integration. Status is completed, failed, interrupted, timeout or bridge_error; anything but completed carries `error`.

brief.description: Full worker brief; sent as the only user message.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory, ideally the unit's own worktree.

role.description: Resolved to a model this Codex account lists; the report names it.

effort.description: Reasoning effort advertised by the model, e.g. low, medium, high.

developer_instructions.description: Role contract layered over the user's Codex AGENTS.md.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the final message; parsed into structured_output.

lean.description: For this thread only, disable every Codex plugin, configured MCP server, the apps connector, goals, the skills catalog, the personality section and (unless web_search) the web search tool.

web_search.description: Keep the web search tool in lean mode; costs ~2.5k input tokens per call.

keep_plugins.description: Plugin ids such as name@marketplace that stay enabled in lean mode.

name: gemini_preview
description: Have a Gemini model (through Antigravity, agy) rewrite worker reports into plain language for the user: what was done, how it turned out, what the user must decide. Put the reports in `prompt`. Without `cwd` it runs in an empty directory, so there is nothing for it to change. Status is completed, failed, timeout or bridge_error; an empty reply is failed with kind empty_response.

cwd.description: Absolute directory agy may read; omit to run in an empty directory.

json_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema; result returned as structured_output.

name: orch
description: Run Pstack's orch bookkeeping CLI (units, inbox, ledger, gates, standing orders, status) on the store for `project`. The store lives in the plugin data directory and survives plugin updates; its path is returned as `store`.

project.description: Lowercase slug naming the program, e.g. todo-stats.

name: memory_record
description: Store one verified unit as long-run memory: what it built, its interface, and what a later worker reusing it must know. Files are hashed so later searches can flag the entry stale once they change.

project.description: Program slug, the same one orch uses.

project_dir.description: Absolute project directory; files are relative to it.

title.description: The module, function or feature, as a later brief would name it.

summary.description: One or two lines: what it does and its interface.

body.description: What a reuser needs: signatures, behaviour decisions, verify command, pitfalls met.

wish.description: The wish verbatim, in the user's words; indexed so searches in their language find the entry.

name: memory_search
description: Find earlier units related to `query` (English words and Chinese both match). Returns titles and summaries only, with `stale` true when a recorded file has changed since; fetch a body with memory_get.

project.description: Limit to one program; omit to search every project.

name: memory_get
description: Return one memory entry in full, with its files and whether it is stale.

name: memory_digest
description: Read a project's short history of wishes and outcomes, one line each; pass `add` to append a line first.

add.description: One line: the wish, the outcome, memory ids.

name: bridge_status
description: Report Codex and agy executable versions, native orchestrator runtime, Java/TLC configuration and Codex app-server state.
